author: kingpanther13
releaseNotes:
v4.3.0 - 2026-09-11
- fix: expire retained request state reliably (#417)
  - Remove expired continuation records without waiting for another write, and avoid repeatedly retrying failed metadata cleanup on every request.
- fix: use native device operations while honoring the allowlist (#420)
  - Device tools use native hub operations while continuing to honor device selection when allowlist bypass is disabled.
  - Configuration updates verify saved values and preserve hidden device metadata more precisely.
  - Virtual-device creation and device deletion provide clearer results when follow-up verification is incomplete.
  - Numeric attributes in poll results and list/context states retain native numeric values instead of always being strings.
  - Device health uses a bulk native activity read; missing metadata is reported as unknown.
  - The context resources and device-list filters read the whole inventory in one bulk hub request; one unreadable device is reported as metadata-unavailable instead of failing the list.
  - Attribute polling keeps its requested interval regardless of native read latency.
  - Health diagnostics use background continuations on supported clients to avoid blocking a cloud-relay response during network probes.
